prompt: After learning something new, which of these does the most to help your brain store it as a lasting memory?

options.text: Staying up all night re-reading it
Learning it again from scratch weekly

explanation: Sleep is when the brain consolidates memories — replaying and stabilising the day's learning — so a good night's sleep after studying protects what you learned far better than an all-night re-read.
